name: Are there any risks or downsides to doing HIIT?
description: Potential risks of HIIT include injury from improper form or overtraining. Proper instruction and listening to your body are crucial to mitigate these.

mainEntity.name: Are there any risks or downsides to doing HIIT?

acceptedAnswer.text: While highly effective, HIIT carries potential risks if not performed correctly, primarily related to injury from improper form or overtraining. The high intensity can also be challenging for individuals with pre-existing heart conditions or severe joint issues. A practical tradeoff is that to gain the full benefits of HIIT, you must commit to pushing your limits, which increases the importance of listening to your body and having qualified instruction. At Cave Training, our focus on proper mechanics and scalable exercises helps mitigate these risks, ensuring a safe environment.
